package.description: A utility to pick color from pallets or screen content.

en-GB.description: A utility to pick colour from pallets or screen content.
en-GB.longDescription: Colour picker that helps you easily select a desired colour using various pallets. It is also able to pick a colour from the currently displayed screen content and supports a number of different colour models, i.e. RGB, HSV, HSL, CMYK.
en-GB.name: Colors
